title: Rödlöga
source:
{{Short description|Cluster of islets in Sweden}}
'''Rödlöga''' is a cluster of [[islet]]s outside in the [[Stockholm archipelago]]. The main island had been permanently inhabited since the 18th century into the 1970s when its last permanent resident, George Nordström, died. Rödlöga is today a spot for boating vacation. [[Location shooting]] took place for the 1938 film ''[[Storm Over the Skerries]]''.<ref>{{cite book|last=Sörenson |first=Ulf |date=2004 |title=Vägvisare till Stockholms skärgård: en kulturguide från Understen till Landsort |trans-title=Guide to Stockholm's archipelago: a cultural guide from Understen to Landsort |location=Stockholm |publisher=Prisma |pages=122–123 |isbn=91-518-4003-0}}</ref>
